gate_evidence_revision._doc: A gate record counts when no file that can change a gate result has changed since the revision it was written at. The whole-tree revision may have moved -- documentation, reporting tools, verification tools -- and that does not invalidate simulation evidence. Any revision listed under `counted_because_gate_code_unchanged` differs from the release revision in files outside `gate_code_paths`.
gate_evidence_revision.policy: a gate record counts when no file that can change a gate result has changed since the revision the record was written at -- not when the whole source tree matches. Documentation, reporting and verification changes move the release revision without invalidating simulation evidence, and the difference is enumerated above rather than assumed

rationale.*_n4_projected*: n4_projected was removed as a duplicate sensitivity arm; the projection now lives in the primary arm's source table
rationale.*fast5*: a five-model fast pass used during development; the current runner does not generate it

orphans.policy: an arm name no longer in the declared registry, or an output family the current runner does not generate, is an orphan and blocks the release

n4_disposition: retained with unidentifiable parameters intact in discovery_only
cohort_label: N3-passing, with N4-unidentifiable dimensions projected out of bbp_l5pc, tomko_ca1
rheobase_search_contract: uniform grid of RHEOBASE_SCAN_POINTS amplitudes spanning (lo, hi] with spacing delta = (hi - lo) / RHEOBASE_SCAN_POINTS, plus lo itself; scanned upward from lo and refined by bisection inside the first bracket that spikes. GUARANTEED: every firing window of width >= delta lying in [lo, hi] is detected, whether or not the ceiling spikes and whether or not firing is monotonic in current. NOT GUARANTEED: firing windows narrower than delta. None therefore means 'no spike at any probed amplitude at this resolution', never 'silent at every real-valued amplitude'.

n2_coverage.statement: source-referenced canonical scalar agreement: 6/14 evaluable implementations
n2_coverage.is_not: trace-level reproduction of a published figure. The published stimulus, temperature and recording site are not distributed with these models; every target is a published SCALAR compared against the COMPASS canonical measurement, and targets whose protocol does not match are marked as such with a widened tolerance.
n2_coverage.roll_up_note: the N2 gate roll-up counts 6 model tests plus one declaration-coverage test; it is not 7 reproduced models

confirmatory_release_gates.note: a condition that cannot be decided from the tree is counted as NOT met. These are the conditions for describing the project as CONFIRMATORY; they are stricter than the fail-closed gate set that decides the release verdict.

1_n2_source_trace_reproduction.requirement: N2 strict source-trace reproduction is implemented

not_evaluable.bbp_l5pc: the recorded value is v_init = -80 mV with e_pas = -90 mV; under Ih the steady state is neither, so v_init is an initialisation setting rather than a published measurement of resting potential
not_evaluable.dougalis_vlpag_da: the model is voltage-clamp-constrained; the source reports conductance densities rather than a current-clamp scalar that the frozen COMPASS protocol measures
not_evaluable.mainen_l5pc: the recorded value is e_pas = v_init = -70 mV, an initialisation setting; the source publishes spike-initiation behaviour rather than a resting potential measured under a stated protocol
not_evaluable.miyasho_purkinje: the recorded justification for every bound is qualitative ('el_Leak = -80 mV with the full dendritic channel set', 'Purkinje high-frequency firing'); no published scalar with a matching measurement condition is recorded in this repository
not_evaluable.moubarak_snc_da: the SNc pacemaking rate recorded here (1-10 Hz in vitro) is a species/preparation range, not a value the source publication reports for THIS reconstruction under a stated protocol; comparing a scalar against it would test the range, not the model
not_evaluable.ortner_snc_da: not simulated (fails N3 and has partial protocol coverage); no N2 target is declared for a model that is excluded from the panel
not_evaluable.tomko_ca1: the recorded value is v_init = -65 mV from the distributed BluePyOpt configuration; the optimised active conductances settle the cell 7.5 mV below it, so v_init does not predict rest and is not an N2 target
not_evaluable.tzilivaki_fsbc: the recorded value is e_pas = v_init = -70 mV; the model is not simulated (fails N1 and N3) and its rest is an initialisation setting, not a published measurement
